sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about school and university life, and say where I study and since when.
I can name school subjects and say which ones I'm good or bad at.
I can say what languages I know and speak using -ul/-ül and tud.
I can describe how I learn and what methods work for me.
I can talk about my language-learning plans and express my hopes and goals.
